h3: Start from a prompt, image or clip

paragraphs: Runway app for iPhone Runway app for Android
Generate, edit, animate and extend video with the most powerful generative models in one place.

When generating with AI video, you choose where to start. Start with an image or existing video if you have one, or prompt from scratch if you don’t. Whichever input you choose, Runway will recommend the AI video model best suited for the job.

AI video generation is just as much about editing as it is about generating from scratch. With Runway, you can use models like Aleph 2.0 or Apps like Remove from Video and Change Video Backdrop to make precise changes until you’re satisfied with the final result.
Once your video is shaping up the way you want, it’s time to finalize. Extend it to full length, upscale it for the resolution your project needs, and export when it’s ready to go.

Generation is only the start. With AI video, editing is just as central to the process. With Runway, easily add or remove an object, change the time of day, relight a scene or swap a backdrop — while keeping the rest of your video footage exactly how you like it.
Change lighting, mood and time of day on existing footage.
Backdrop swap — outdoor → studio
Replace any background without masking or rotoscoping.
Place, move or erase elements from a real clip with a text prompt.
With text to video AI generation, your description is the only input you need. Write out the scene — the action, the setting, the mood — and Runway turns it into a clip from scratch.
Use Runway as an AI animation generator for anything from subtle movement to full-scene action. Give static visuals motion that feels intentional while staying aligned with your creative direction.
Turn a still character into a performance with expressions, gestures and movement.
Add motion and camera direction to static product imagery.
Turn concept art and still compositions into moving shots.

Upload an image or video of your character as a reference to maintain that exact character’s look and feel across everything you generate. With references in Runway, the same character shows up in shot two, three and ten without drifting.
AI video with sound, start to finish. Generate dialogue and music during generation on supported models, or add voiceover and music to any clip afterward.
